notes.title: My Sexy Neighbor: Prologue 🔞 is out!
notes.notes:
[h3]Prepare to dive into My Sexy Neighbor, a game of intrigue, stealth, and temptation! 

The prologue introduces you to Lola, your alluring neighbor, as you navigate four eventful days packed with mischievous encounters and clever setups. 

From helping her with a “leaky faucet” to sneaking into her house for a closer look, every day presents new opportunities and risks.

Master the stealth system, improve your skills, and unlock exciting quests as you peek, snap photos, and plant traps without getting caught. With the prologue’s unique gameplay features, you’ll get a taste of what’s to come in the full game.

Are you up for the challenge? 📸

[b]Download and play the game now - take a look at what's coming later in the full version![/b] [/h3]
